sources.title: lalph README
sources.finding: LLM agent orchestrator driven by an issue source (GitHub Issues, Linear); projects with concurrency, branch, git flow and review agent; agent presets; plan mode; git worktrees; optional PR flow with auto-merge and issue dependencies; npm install; .lalph/ credentials note.

sources.title: Package manifest
sources.finding: Version 0.3.139, bin lalph, MIT licence, Node CLI built with tsdown; dependencies tree-sitter and optional sqlite-vector natives; Effect 4 beta.

sources.title: MIT licence
sources.finding: MIT licence text (Tim Smart).

sources.title: CLI agent definitions
sources.finding: Five agents: clanka (built-in), opencode, claude, codex, amp; each builds a child process command with prompt and PRD file; plan mode unsupported for amp; dangerous flags.

sources.title: Agent preset schema
sources.finding: Preset has cliAgent, extra args, command prefix, optional routing metadata.

sources.title: Preset prompts
sources.finding: Interactive creation asks for CLI agent, extra args, command prefix; first run requires a default preset.

sources.title: Built-in clanka runner
sources.finding: Runs the clanka agent with OpenAI-compatible config via LALPH_OPENAI_API_KEY or device-code login for OpenAI and Copilot; model/provider/reasoning from preset extra args.

sources.title: Clanka model parsing
sources.finding: Providers openai and copilot with reasoning low/medium/high/xhigh; claude-prefixed models mapped.

sources.title: Main loop iteration
sources.finding: Per iteration: choose task, optional research agent, run agent with stall and run timeouts, optional review agent, git flow post-work and auto-merge.

sources.title: Loop and flags
sources.finding: Semaphore of project concurrency; iterations flag (default unlimited); max-minutes default 90 or LALPH_MAX_MINUTES; max-context 250000; stall-minutes default 5; specs directory; verbose.

sources.title: Project schema
sources.finding: Project: enabled, targetBranch, concurrency >= 1, gitFlow pr/commit/ralph, ralph spec and preset, researchAgent, reviewAgent.

sources.title: Settings store
sources.finding: Project and global settings persisted through key-value stores under .lalph.

sources.title: Key-value storage
sources.finding: File-system KV under <repo>/.lalph/config and .lalph/projects/<id>.

sources.title: Worktree manager
sources.finding: Creates a temporary git worktree per iteration at HEAD (detached), shares .lalph/shared, runs a worktree-setup script, removes the worktree on finish; reuses cwd when .lalph/prd.yml exists.

sources.title: Git flow layers
sources.finding: GitFlowPR (agent opens PR via gh; auto-merge with gh pr merge -sd), GitFlowCommit (commits to target branch), GitFlowRalph; postWork and autoMerge hooks.

sources.title: PRD issue schema
sources.finding: Issue with priority 0-4, estimate, state backlog/todo/in-progress/in-review/done, blockedBy, autoMerge, description.

sources.title: PRD file sync
sources.finding: Local .lalph/prd.yml mirrors issues from the issue source and syncs changes back.

sources.title: IssueSource service
sources.finding: Abstraction: list/create/update/delete issues, comments, changes stream, polling.

sources.title: Issue source selection
sources.finding: Sources: Linear and GitHub Issues; resetInProgress.

sources.title: GitHub issue source
sources.finding: Label filter, project filter, auto-merge label, recently closed handling through Octokit.

sources.title: Linear issue source
sources.finding: Linear SDK issue source with project/label selection and sync.

sources.title: GitHub auth
sources.finding: PAT (repo, read:user, read:project) or OAuth device code; token stored in the .lalph key-value store.

sources.title: Linear auth
sources.finding: Linear token manager stored in the .lalph store.

sources.title: Task tools
sources.finding: Tools given to the planning/chooser agent: listTasks, createTask, findTaskById, updateTask, removeTask, chooseTask, listEligibleTasks.

sources.title: Prompt generation
sources.finding: Prompts instruct the agent to update .lalph/prd.yml, write task.json, commit, open a PR or push; timeout, review and ralph prompts.

sources.title: Plan command
sources.finding: Opens an editor (or --file), generates a spec under --specs, then creates PRD tasks; --dangerous skips permission prompts; --new creates a project.

sources.title: Issue command
sources.finding: lalph issue opens a template in the editor and creates the issue in the current source.

sources.title: CLI entry
sources.finding: Subcommands: root loop, agents, projects, plan, issue, source, sh, edit.

sources.title: sh command
sources.finding: Launches an interactive shell in the active project worktree.

sources.title: Review agent
sources.finding: Optional review pass; reads custom LALPH_REVIEW.md from the worktree with {TASK_INSTRUCTIONS}.

sources.title: Tracing layer
sources.finding: Local trace-level logging only; no exporter.

sources.title: Specification index
sources.finding: Specs for cli-agent presets, ralph mode cleanup, PRD service polling sync.

sources.title: Changelog
sources.finding: Changesets-based changelog per version.

sources.title: GitHub repository metadata
sources.finding: 137 stars at the check; MIT; no homepage or description; last push 2026-10-11; not archived.

sources.title: Release v0.3.139
sources.finding: Latest tagged release 2026-07-08 (commit ea5f004), published to npm as 0.3.139; the default branch has later commits (effect 4.0.3 upgrade on 2026-10-12) that are not in the pinned release.

sources.title: npm registry entry
sources.finding: npm latest 0.3.139, homepage the GitHub repository.

sources.title: Repository issues and PRs
sources.finding: Open proposal #469 for an execution-backend seam so multiplexers can run lalph agents; bug #464 about prd.yml after issue creation; no roadmap.

sources.title: PR 154 attachment
sources.finding: Contributor screenshot of a real lalph run (Claude Code stream output, task selection from prd.yml, cost and duration line).

sources.title: Bounded search: clients and UI
sources.finding: No server, web UI, desktop or mobile client; interactive terminal prompts and streamed agent output only.

sources.title: Bounded search: remote, cloud, containers
sources.finding: No SSH, container, VM or cloud execution; local child processes. Presets accept a command prefix that a user can use to wrap commands.

sources.title: Bounded search: telemetry
sources.finding: No telemetry or analytics; the only network calls are issue-source APIs, GitHub OAuth, OpenAI/Copilot for clanka and update checks by npm.

sources.title: Bounded search: collaboration, roles, approvals
sources.finding: No roles, SSO or approvals; GitHub comments are read as context; assignment fields come from the tracker.

sources.title: Bounded search: cost, usage, spend
sources.finding: max-context token guard and agent-reported cost lines only; no usage accounting or spend limits.

sources.title: Bounded search: MCP, schedules, webhooks, review gates
sources.finding: No MCP client or server, scheduler or webhook; the loop polls the issue source.

sources.title: Claude stream-json transformer
sources.locator: total_cost_usd schema field and result rendering near L230-L238
sources.finding: The Claude result message schema includes total_cost_usd and lalph renders the result as 'Done' followed by the run duration and the cost formatted to four decimals in the streamed terminal output; no other agent's cost is parsed in this file and no totals are stored.

sources.title: lalph pinned source, bounded telemetry search
sources.locator: Recursive search of src for posthog, segment, amplitude, mixpanel, sentry, aptabase, telemetry, DO_NOT_TRACK, google-analytics, gtag, firebase/analytics, opentelemetry
sources.finding: No ADE analytics, telemetry or crash-reporting client in the pinned source. src/ has no matches; OpenTelemetry hits are only in the vendored Effect library under repos/effect, which lalph does not configure with an exporter.
